# The Casino & The Church

> A pixel RPG on NEAR testnet. Crypto's two cultures are two realms: the Casino (LUCK, on-chain games) and the
> Church (FAITH, tithes, quests). Staying in one drains the other, so balance is survival. Every chip and bet lives in
> one NEAR contract; two AI hosts on NEAR AI Cloud run the house with signed decisions; a BTC UP/DOWN market is priced
> by an OutLayer TEE oracle. Play money only.

Live game: https://casino-and-church.vercel.app
Contract: realm.casinonchurch.testnet (NEAR testnet)
API health: https://server-production-d070a910.up.railway.app/healthz
Start here: AGENT_README.md (what was built, claim-to-code map), then AGENTS.md (step-by-step testing guide)
Repository: https://github.com/tsmboa0/casino-and-church

## Quick start for agents

- Offline demo, no account, straight into the world: https://casino-and-church.vercel.app/?demo=1&agent=1
- Open one place directly: add &play=<place>, e.g. https://casino-and-church.vercel.app/?demo=1&agent=1&play=market
- Real on-chain game: https://casino-and-church.vercel.app/?agent=1 then SIGN UP (username, password of 10+
  characters, typed twice), pick a character. 30 welcome chips arrive on chain in a few seconds.

URL parameters: agent=1 (no splash, no backstory, no tours, no music) · demo=1 (offline demo) · play=<place>.

## Moving without the canvas

Every panel is HTML. Use the Places button (map icon, #btn-places) or the page API:

- cnc.state(): mode, signedIn, profile, realm, chips, luck, faith, panelOpen, panelTitle
- cnc.places(): every location as {id, kind, label, realm}
- cnc.go('<place>'): go there and open it
- cnc.close(): close the open panel (Escape does too)

Places: cashier, slots-west, slots-east, wheel, market (BTC), blackjack, roulette, coinflip, dice, plot-1..3, monitor,
npc-owner (Don Fortuna), harmony, board, altar, missions, candles, offering, confessional, ledger, commission,
npc-priest (Father Nakamoto). Aliases: btc, don, priest, desk, quests.

Panels: #modal .gm[role=dialog], title in .gm-title span. Results: #res[role=status], with an explorer link on the
live game. Toasts: #toasts[role=log].

## Facts worth knowing

- 1 chip = 0.01 NEAR. Casino bets are 10 chips. Cashier: GET FREE TEST NEAR (or FUND WALLET to send your own
  testnet NEAR to your account), then BUY CHIPS. Your account address is also in Settings, with a copy button.
- Bets are gasless meta-transactions (NEP-366). Games are commit-reveal: the dealer commits before you bet.
- BTC Exchange: 1-minute rounds, 1.9x on the right call, a tie refunds; prices from the OutLayer TEE oracle.
- AI hosts decide every 10 minutes; each decision is signed and its hash anchored on chain (verify on the board).
- Accounts: the password never leaves the browser; the server keeps only a hash and a sealed wallet copy.
- Run locally: pnpm install && pnpm dev (offline demo with placeholder art); pnpm test runs every test suite.
